mechanism_summary: The RoleBinding inventory-reader-binding's subject names ServiceAccount inventory-synk — a typo for inventory-sync — so the sync worker's ServiceAccount is never bound to the inventory-reader Role and its API reads are denied with 403 Forbidden while the worker quietly keeps serving stale data.
decisive_evidence: inventory-sync logs show 'identity=inventory-sync discovery=ok' (the token is sent and accepted) followed by 403 Forbidden on the namespaced read; the captured RoleBinding JSON shows subject inventory-synk while the only ServiceAccount in the namespace is inventory-sync — the one-letter diff between binding subject and actual SA is the fault.
remediation_summary: Fix the binding's subject to the real ServiceAccount: kubectl -n inventory patch rolebinding inventory-reader-binding --type=json -p '[{"op":"replace","path":"/subjects/0/name","value":"inventory-sync"}]'; within one 10s sync cycle the worker logs 'sync ok: fetched inventory-sources' and fresh data flows with no workload change.
